description:
The memory-first coding agent

Letta Code is a memory-first coding harness, designed for long-lived agents that can learn from experience.
Instead of working in independent sessions, you work with a persisted agent whose memory is portable across models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, Kimi, and more).
What's Changed
- docs(agents): treat internal names and IDs as internal in public examples by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/5446
- docs: add speech word timings example by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/5442
- feat(subagents): stream Letta subagent progress into the task output file by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/5447
- feat(subagents): full JSONL event log for every subagent task, including remote workers by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/5448
- chore: bump version to 0.34.38 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/5445
Full Changelog: https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/compare/v0.34.37...v0.34.38
